title: NASA Extravehicular Mobility Unit (EMU) Spacesuit During EVA
author: NASA
caption: NASA astronaut performing an extravehicular activity (EVA) in the Extravehicular Mobility Unit (EMU) spacesuit.
alt_text: Astronaut in white NASA EMU spacesuit tethered outside spacecraft during extravehicular activity.
clinical_relevance: Illustrates the operational EVA spacesuit environment where high metabolic heat/sweat loss and constrained fluid intake cause EVA-related dehydration (CLIFF-013, p.1-2).
